name: 会話の文字書式を選ぶ操作バー
prompt:
Refine only the supplied v001 toolbar against the native preview. Preserve the exact 390×39 crop, white background, divider, order, control widths, selected-state surface, and typography family. The first version matches the general composition but its Japanese glyphs look about 10–15% too large, and the selected 太字 control sits about 5–7px too far left. Reduce label glyph height by roughly 12%; align labels and control centers to the native x positions: control frames begin at 8,45,82,119,156,193,238,295,332 px; text begins at 10,47,84,121,158,195,240,297,334 px. Keep the selected 太字 frame 36px wide and move it about 6px right. Preserve Meiryo regular 12px/16px rhythm; use bold only for 太字.

Keep 反応, 宛先, 斜体, 取消, リンク, 箇条書き, 番号, 字下げ in neutral #6E6E6E. Keep the selected 太字 text #047857 on pale mint #ECFDF5. The word リンク is a toolbar command, not hyperlink content; leave it gray. No blue text belongs in this toolbar, no actual hyperlink text is present. Match the native preview's compact crop and clip; remove blank margins and do not add vertical padding, icons, shadows, borders, or new content. Output only the horizontal toolbar.
